model_annotation: The image displays three donut charts illustrating the distribution of enterprises, employment, and turnover across four economic sectors—Industry, Construction, Trade, and Other Services—in 2021, based on NACE Rev. 2 classification. Each chart is segmented into four colored portions corresponding to the sectors, with a legend at the bottom indicating that Industry is gold, Construction is blue, Trade is red, and Other Services is dark blue. The first chart, labeled “NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES,” shows Industry at 8% (2.4 million), Construction at 12% (3.7 million), Trade at 19% (5.9 million), and Other Services at 61% (19.0 million). The second chart, “NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED,” depicts Industry at 21% (33.0 million), Construction at 51% (80.2 million), Trade at 19% (29.5 million), and Other Services at 9% (13.4 million). The third chart, “TURNOVER,” indicates Industry at 33% (10.9 billion), Construction at 31% (9.8 billion), Trade at 21% (9.0 billion), and Other Services at 6% (1.9 billion). All three charts include percentage labels and absolute values within their respective segments, and none of the segments are visually emphasized or rearranged; they appear in a clockwise sequence starting from the top-left position.
